purpose: Determine whether H1 actually produces, retains and consumes score estimates while preserving useful legal completed-move guidance; no strength inference
selection: Start position plus first eight frozen bridge-v1 legal histories, without selecting on diagnostic or game results
resources: Hash64, 2097152 direct-mapped entries, 50331648 entry bytes, same arrays/locks; 100000 admitted nodes per request, target depth40, 30s operational deadline; W1 and ROOT_REUSE W4

decision: If H1 has meaningful retained scores and actual eligible cutoffs, correctness remains qualified, and hints survive, run a prospectively frozen exploratory playing-strength screen.
